 MEXICO — Mexico Academy and Central Schools senior Allie Poissant will continue her soccer career at the NCAA Division I level after signing to play women’s soccer at the University at Albany.
 Poissant has been a fixture of the Mexico girls varsity soccer program since joining the team in eighth grade, developing into one of the program’s most accomplished players. During her time with the Tigers, she surpassed the 100-goal mark, establishing herself as a prolific scorer while also becoming an important leader and teammate.
